parameters.description: Native trade lookup identifier; stable record identity remains unproven.

parameters.name: transact-from
parameters.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD in UTC+08 or explicit-offset ISO instant.

parameters.name: transact-to
parameters.description: Inclusive bound paired with transact-from. Omitted ID and dates uses the previous complete UTC+08 day.

identity_description: Stable record identity has not been established.
limitations: Identity and native total semantics remain unproven; complete=false and strict completeness rejects.
Business filters are online only; cached mappings are unverified.
Acquisition is bounded to 100 pages and 120 seconds.
Field types describe verified native representations; fields may be absent or null, unknown fields are preserved, and documentation never coerces records.
SDK refresh requires proven completeness; this leaf cannot publish a cache until identity and total semantics are qualified.
